# Support

Country Proxy is a personal open-source project. There is no response-time or
fix guarantee. English and Russian reports are welcome.

Start with the [English guide](../docs/getting-started.md) or
[Russian troubleshooting guide](../docs/runbook.md). To restore the profile's
route, press **Отключить** (Disconnect). If the popup fails, disable Country Proxy
in `chrome://extensions`.

For a reproducible bug or a feature suggestion, search
[existing issues](https://github.com/Nelmad/country-proxy/issues), then use the
matching [issue template](https://github.com/Nelmad/country-proxy/issues/new/choose).
General usage questions can use a blank issue with a clear question and the
relevant versions. No separate chat or Discussions support channel is advertised.

Include the release version (or source commit, if known), macOS/Chrome/Python
versions, selected country codes, visible status, expected/actual result and a few
steps to reproduce. A country having no working public proxies is different from
a broken installer or routing defect. Do not run long network tests just to ask
for help; report what you actually observed.

Issues and attachments are public. Share only the relevant error code or a short
sanitized summary. Remove IP addresses, proxy endpoints, full request URLs, tokens,
passwords, personal paths, page contents and account details. Do not upload raw
NetLogs, complete logs, Chrome profiles or unredacted screenshots. You do not need
to disclose which personal sites or accounts you used.

For a suspected vulnerability, use the [security reporting instructions](SECURITY.md)
instead of a public bug report with technical details.
